name: Seven Stars Solar Water Heater
shortDescription: Vacuum-tube solar water heater that turns sunlight into free hot water for homes, guesthouses and hostels.
description: The Seven Stars solar water heater uses high-vacuum borosilicate glass tubes to absorb heat from the sun and store it in an insulated stainless steel tank, giving you hot water every morning without running up your electricity bill. It works well even on cloudy Kenyan days and needs almost no maintenance once installed. We supply and install the full range of tank sizes and can size a system to match your household or hostel's hot water demand.

specs.Warranty: Up to 5 years on tank, 3 years on tubes

name: Lutan Solar Submersible Borehole Pump
shortDescription: DC solar-powered submersible pump for boreholes and deep wells, built for off-grid and farm water supply.
description: This solar submersible screw pump draws water straight from a borehole or deep well using power from a connected solar panel array, no grid electricity required. It is a popular choice for farms, rural homes and institutions that need a dependable water supply in areas with unreliable power. We handle sizing, solar panel matching and full installation.

name: Vestwoods 12.8V 200Ah Lithium-Ion Battery
shortDescription: Long-life LiFePO4 battery for solar and backup power storage, built for thousands of charge cycles.
description: The Vestwoods VC12200 Plus is a 12.8V 200Ah lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) battery designed for solar storage and backup power systems. It charges faster, lasts longer and weighs less than an equivalent lead-acid battery, with a built-in battery management system for safe charging and discharging. A solid upgrade for anyone tired of replacing gel or acid batteries every couple of years.

name: Polycrystalline Solar Panels
shortDescription: Durable polycrystalline solar panels for residential, commercial and off-grid solar installations.
description: We stock a range of polycrystalline solar panel wattages to match residential rooftop systems, commercial installations and off-grid setups like borehole pumping. All panels are supplied with standard mounting hardware and can be paired with our range of inverters, charge controllers and batteries for a complete solar solution.

specs.Warranty: Up to 10 years product, 25 years performance

name: Vestwoods Portable Power Station
shortDescription: Solar-ready portable power station with a 1kWh LiFePO4 battery, ideal for home backup and outdoor use.
description: The Vestwoods Power Station is a compact, solar-ready battery bank that keeps essential appliances running during a blackout and doubles as portable power for outdoor use, small offices and shops. It charges from the wall, from a car socket, or straight from a solar panel, and its smart battery management system protects against overcharge and overheating.

name: ALLTOP Energy Bean Energy Storage System
shortDescription: Wall-friendly energy storage unit that keeps power on tap for homes and small businesses.
description: The Energy Bean is a compact energy storage system built for homes and small businesses that want reliable backup power without a large inverter and battery bank taking over a room. A single power button starts it up, and an onboard battery gauge shows charge level at a glance.

specs.Controls: One-touch power button, battery level indicator

name: Deep Cycle & Solar Gel Battery Range
shortDescription: Maintenance-free deep cycle gel and lithium batteries for UPS, solar and standby power systems.
description: We stock a full range of deep cycle batteries for solar systems, UPS backup and standby power, from compact 12V units to high-capacity 100Ah+ gel and lithium options. These maintenance-free batteries are built for repeated deep discharge cycles, which makes them a better fit for solar and backup use than a standard car battery.

specs.Common Use: Solar storage, UPS backup, standby power

name: Tronic EM DT25 Digital Timer Switch
shortDescription: Programmable digital timer switch for automating lights, pumps and appliances on a daily or weekly schedule.
description: The Tronic EM DT25 digital timer switch lets you automate any connected load, from security lighting to water pumps, on a precise daily or weekly programme. It mounts on a standard DIN rail and includes manual override so you are never locked out of controlling the load directly.

name: Tronic Refrigerator Guard VP FG13-BS
shortDescription: Plug-in voltage protector that shields refrigerators and similar appliances from power fluctuations.
description: Kenya's power grid can spike or dip without warning, and that is exactly what damages a refrigerator's compressor. The Tronic Refrigerator Guard monitors voltage continuously and automatically cuts power during unsafe conditions, with a built-in delay function that prevents rapid on/off switching from harming the compressor.

specs.Protection: High and low voltage, auto cut-off

name: Tronic Automatic Voltage Switcher AVS30
shortDescription: Automatic voltage switcher with digital display that protects appliances from high and low voltage.
description: The Tronic AVS30 continuously monitors incoming voltage and automatically regulates it within a safe range, protecting sensitive electronics and appliances from both surges and brownouts. A digital display shows real-time voltage and current, and a time-delay function adds an extra layer of protection during switching.

name: Tronic Motor Protection Circuit Breaker (MPCB)
shortDescription: Motor protection circuit breaker for overload and short-circuit protection on industrial and commercial motors.
description: The Tronic MPCB protects three-phase motors from overload and short-circuit conditions, with manual start/stop controls and clear ON/OFF indication. It is a standard component in our industrial and commercial control panel installations for pumps, compressors and other motor-driven equipment.

name: Tronic Manual Changeover Switch (CO KTKO)
shortDescription: Heavy-duty manual changeover switch for safely switching between mains and generator power.
description: This manual changeover switch lets you safely switch a property's supply between mains power and a standby generator, preventing dangerous back-feed onto the grid. Available in 40A and 80A ratings to match different generator and load sizes, and built into an IP-rated enclosure for safe indoor or covered outdoor mounting.

name: Tronic PVC Insulated Electrical Cables
shortDescription: Flame-retardant PVC insulated copper cables for residential and commercial wiring.
description: We stock Tronic's PVC insulated single-core cables in the sizes used for everyday residential and commercial wiring, from lighting circuits to socket outlets. All cables use flame-retardant insulation over pure copper conductors and meet standard electrical safety requirements.

name: Copper Earthing & Lightning Protection Rods
shortDescription: Copper earth rods and lightning arrestor kits for a safe, code-compliant electrical earthing system.
description: Proper earthing protects people and equipment by giving fault current a safe path to ground, and it is one of the most overlooked parts of an electrical installation. We supply and install copper earth rods and multi-point lightning arrestor kits for residential, commercial and industrial buildings, sized to the property and soil conditions.

specs.Installation: Ground rod driving and bonding included

name: Tronic Light Control Sensor (Photocell)
shortDescription: Dusk-to-dawn photocell sensor that automatically switches outdoor lighting on and off.
description: This weatherproof photocell automatically switches connected outdoor lights on at dusk and off at dawn, cutting energy waste from lights left running during the day. It is a simple, reliable add-on for compound lighting, security floodlights and street lighting.

name: ALLTOP All-in-One Solar LED Street Light
shortDescription: Integrated solar street light with radar motion sensor, built for estates, roads and compound lighting.
description: This all-in-one solar street light combines the solar panel, battery, LED array and radar motion sensor in a single weatherproof housing, so there is no separate wiring or battery box to install. The radar sensor dims the light in standby mode and brightens automatically when it detects movement, stretching battery life through the night.

name: ATTA Solar LED Flood Light
shortDescription: High-output solar flood light with remote control, ideal for compounds, car parks and building perimeters.
description: A powerful solar flood light for lighting up compounds, car parks and building exteriors without adding to your electricity bill. It comes as a complete kit with a separate solar panel, mounting bracket and remote control, and is rated IP65 for outdoor use in all weather. Available in 300W and 400W output options.

name: MODI Gold Crystal Chandelier
shortDescription: Statement gold-finish crystal chandelier for living rooms, dining areas and hotel lobbies.
description: A layered gold-finish chandelier with cascading crystal drops that adds a hotel-lobby feel to living rooms, dining areas and reception spaces. Available in multiple sizes to suit different ceiling heights and room proportions; ask us for the size guide when placing an order.

specs.Use: Living rooms, dining areas, hospitality spaces

name: MODI Black & Gold Crystal Chandelier
shortDescription: Modern black and gold crystal chandelier for a bolder, contemporary statement ceiling light.
description: This two-tone black and gold chandelier suits contemporary interiors that want a chandelier's drama without the fully traditional gold look. Layered crystal drops catch the light from every angle, making it a strong centrepiece for a living room, staircase void or hotel restaurant.

specs.Finish: Black and gold frame with crystal drops

name: Crystal LED Wall Sconce
shortDescription: Decorative crystal wall sconce with warm LED glow, ideal for hallways, staircases and feature walls.
description: A compact crystal wall sconce that adds a soft decorative glow to hallways, staircases and feature walls. Its faceted crystal shade throws a warm, layered light and suits both modern and classic interiors.

name: Decorative Outdoor Lantern Light
shortDescription: Classic lantern-style outdoor light for gate posts, driveways and garden pathways.
description: A traditional lantern-style fitting with a weatherproof glass enclosure, well suited to gate posts, driveway pillars and garden pathway lighting. Pair it with our photocell sensor for automatic dusk-to-dawn operation.

specs.Style: Classic lantern, post or wall mount

name: Shiyanshi Hot Aerosol Fire Extinguisher for MCBs
shortDescription: Automatic heat-aerosol fire suppression device that protects distribution boards from overheating faults.
description: This compact device mounts inside a distribution board or MCB enclosure and automatically releases a non-toxic fire-suppressing aerosol within seconds of detecting overheating, well before an electrical fault can turn into a fire. It is maintenance-free and rated for up to 10 years of standby protection, a low-cost addition to any board upgrade or new installation.
